To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a synthetic anti-cancers PG induces G1 arrest via p53-independent p21 induction, and that this action is modulated by a specific inhibitor of ATP-dependent glutathion S-conjugate (GS) export pump (GSX pump).
a synthetic anti-cancers PG induces cell cycle arrest in human leukaemic cells and this effect is modulated by the GS-X pump.
the GS-X pump plays a pivotal role in determining the biological action of anti-cancer PG.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of action of the anti-tumour agent Delta7-PGA methyl ester.
the mechanism of action of a novel class of anti-cancer PGs.
the molecular mechanisms underlying the anti-cancer activity of the PGs and their analogues.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Delta7-PG methyl ester induces p21 expression, and that this induction is associated with the suppression of c-my and the G1 arrest of cells.
the ATP-dependent glutahione S-conjugation export pump (GSX pump) plays a key role in modulating Delta7-PGA-1 methyl ester-induced cell-cycle arrest in HL-60 and HL-60/RCP cells.
the anti-cancer prostaglandin Delta7-PGA-1 methyl ester inhibits cancer cell growth by suppressing c-myc gene transcription and inducing G1 arrest via the p21-cdk-cyclin-pRB pathway.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the anti-cancer prostaglandins induce cell-cycle arrest in cancer cells, and this action is modulated by the GS-X pump.
the anti-cancer action of the A series PGs is due to their ability to accumulate in the nuclei of cancer cells, where they suppress the expression of c-myc and induce p21.
the anti-cancer-prostagladin-induced G1 arrest is mediated via the induction of p21 and that the p53-dependent pathway is not involved in the induction of p53 in the HL-60 cells used.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GS-X pump is involved in the resistance of cancer cells to the anti-cancer action of Delta7-PGE1 methyl ester.

the GS-X pump is a novel molecular target for the development of anti-cancer agents and that the GS-X transport system plays a pivotal role in the cellular response to the anti-cancer action of the anti-prostaglandins.
the ATP-dependent glutahione S-conjugated export pump (GS-XP) is a key factor that determines the sensitivity of cancer cells to the anti-tumor effects of Delta7-PG methyl ester.
